coupon_description: <p>Dandy's World is a multiplayer mascot horror game created by BlushCrunch Studio. It is recommended for players aged nine and above. While the game does not include jump scares, it does contain some disturbing material. Players complete tasks such as completing machines or completing mastery quests to assist themselves and their allies as they progress through the floors.</p>
